name: Afflictions Made Beneficial
overview: Scripture reveals that afflictions serve a divine purpose in shaping believers, as seen in the experiences of Abraham, Joseph, and his brethren. God’s testing, like Abraham's trial with Isaac, challenges faith and obedience, while the distress of Joseph's brothers leads to conviction of sin and ultimately God's providential preservation of life. These afflictions are not random but are used by God to preserve His people, promote repentance, and fulfill His sovereign will.
